function mandatory<T extends (() => number) | undefined>(fn: T): number {
  return fn();
}
function parenthesized<T extends (() => () => number) | undefined>(fn: T): number | undefined {
  return (fn?.())();
}
function absent<T extends undefined>(fn: T): undefined {
  return fn?.();
}
function wrongReturn<T extends (() => number) | undefined>(fn: T): number {
  return fn?.();
}
function wrongArgs<T extends ((x: string) => number) | null>(fn: T): number | undefined {
  return fn?.(123);
}
function nestedMissing<T extends (() => (() => number) | undefined) | null>(fn: T) {
  return fn?.()();
}
